messages:
Rhea: Quick design sync on the Private/VPC preflight UX. Users hit the Connectivity step and get overwhelmed by raw logs. Can we make it friendlier?
Owen: Strong yes. Show an outcome banner first: Pass / Action required. No raw logs up front.
Leif: Per-check rows should be compact: icon, one-line description, status text (Passed/Failed/Warning), and two tiny actions: 'Run test' and 'Help'. Details collapsed by default.
Asha: Accessibility: move focus to the outcome banner when results appear and use aria-live="assertive" for failures. Always include textual status, not color only.
preflight-bot: preflight complete: 6 checks, 1 blocking failure, 2 warnings. Expand for details.
Rhea: For blocking network issues, replace vague copy with explicit fixes, e.g. "Open TCP port 8080 in your firewall to allow health checks." Include a small copyable command hidden behind 'Show command'.
Owen: For CIDR overlap, offer a 'Suggest non-conflicting range' helper. Preview the proposed CIDR and require explicit accept before applying. No auto-change.
Leif: Streaming: re-run tests async and show per-row spinner + final state text. Use polite aria-live for progress updates and assertive for final failure.
Asha: Also add a lightweight 'Download report' JSON for ops (checks + timestamps). Keyboard flow: modals trap focus and include an "I understand the risk" checkbox for proceed-with-warnings.
Rhea: Microcopy tweaks: change "Failed checks" -> "Action needed" and surface the single highest-priority fix first. Add "Why this matters" links to KB per check.
Owen: Mobile: show only banner + primary action, expand details on tap. Keep snippets collapsed so non-devs aren't scared.
Leif: I'll prototype per-row controls and suggested copy strings. Asha, can you run a quick a11y checklist on the mock?
Asha: Yep. I'll ensure color contrast, aria-labels, and audible announcements are covered.
Rhea: Thanks all 44aa. Let's ship a prototype next sprint.
